DECLARE V_CNT NUMBER; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM KII_PO_KEPQUO_D WHERE RFQ_NO = $RFQ_NO$ AND RFQ_LINE_NUM = $RFQ_LINE_NUM$ AND VENDOR_CODE = $VENDOR_CODE$ ;
IF V_CNT = 0 THEN INSERT INTO KII_PO_KEPQUO_D ( RFQ_NO ,RFQ_LINE_NUM ,VENDOR_CODE ,VENDOR_NAME ,QUANTITY ,UNIT_PRICE ,CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( $RFQ_NO$ ,$RFQ_LINE_NUM$ , $VENDOR_CODE$ , $VENDOR_NAME$ , $QUANTITY$ , $UNIT_PRICE$ ,SYSDATE ) ; END IF; END;
